live_backend.note: The CLI is still --backend rules. lgbm is promoted on after-cost mean and is not the live backend.

closed_fills.note: Sell fills with a finite P&L. Flat zero is excluded, same as sleeve Win %. The scrubbed tape has no order id, so rows are not collapsed. T24b will improve joined-fill metrics.

fee_drag.note: Sum of crypto fee dollars on the rows that were read. Identifiers are not written. Measured live fee ~95 bps/leg (median) / ~190 RT from tape. T24d will set FEE_BPS from that. This read median 95 bps/leg (~190 RT).

kill.note: Same reading as the crypto sleeve card. A stored absolute value above 1 is percent points.

oos.benchmark_note: Crypto sleeve_ir_vs_spy uses BTC-USD hourly, not SPY. LightGBM promotion is after-cost mean only.
oos.note: Out-of-sample after-cost uses 30 bp. Measured live fee ~95 bps/leg (median) / ~190 RT from tape. T24d will set FEE_BPS from that.

last_train.note: No separate train or promote timestamp is in the exported model files.

signal_linkage.note: Counts only. The artifact payload stays in the warehouse.
